item.title: all new/renewed Let's Encrypt certificates will use a 64 day lifetime
item.description: On February 10, 2027, all Let’s Encrypt subscribers will move to certificates with 64 day lifetimes by default unless they select an even shorter lifetime (45 or 6 days, as previously announced). (1 source: frontendfocus)
